description.narrative: Study visit to an EU country (Poland) will be organized to familiarize the group members with good practices and prepare for making recommendations and strategies for NQF level 5. We will pay much attention to this aspect and are committed to pursuing such opportunities or facilitating and even formalizing networking contacts between EU Member State institutions and relevant bodies in Azerbaijan.
